subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should maintainers sponsor a focused current-main Slack `channel-info`/`channel-list` implementation now that the broad parity PR was closed unmerged?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the work adds agent-facing Slack action surface and prior broad attempts carried security/config/merge-unit concerns, so automation should not queue another PR without maintainer scope approval.

options.title: Sponsor focused Slack discovery
options.body: Land only `channel-info` and `channel-list` in the Slack plugin with existing read authorization, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery
options.body: Keep this issue open without a repair job until Slack action-surface priorities are revisited.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Close this request if maintainers decide agents should not get Slack channel metadata/listing actions.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused Slack discovery
recommendation.body: Land only `channel-info` and `channel-list` in the Slack plugin with existing read authorization, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the closed broad parity PR and left the clearest maintainer-direction comment for focused current-main follow-ups.
